request: Strip the manual formatting so everything follows the styles again
summary: Every run, paragraph mark and paragraph of the body loses its direct formatting (fonts, sizes, bold, colour, spacing, indents, alignment, borders, shading, tab stops, keep/page-break flags), so the styles apply again; hidden text, list numbers, highlights, superscripts and symbol fonts stay.
assumptions: the styles themselves are not changed; character and paragraph styles stay applied
hidden text stays hidden, list numbers stay, highlight and superscript/subscript stay (not asked), the proofing language stays
symbol and Wingdings runs keep their font and caps; their other direct formatting is cleared
a whole-document change is plain formatting (decision 14.1)
